properties.description: DesignGraph::node_edges: every edge on a node with its type, direction, from/to, the other end (id, type, name, resolved across every node type and never guessed), its properties and twin_of. Filters by direction and edge types, orders rarest type first, bounds by limit and by the shared reply budget (spent_chars for what the caller sends beside it), and reports total, by_type, matched, filtered_out, omitted, next_offset, capped_by, dominant and empty_because.
properties.name: crates/reflow2-core/src/node_edges.rs — one node's edges read back as edges: both directions, the other end named, each edge's own properties, twins marked, filtered and bounded
